name: inkwell
description: Create private handwritten PDF, Word, and PNG notes through a CLI, MCP tool, or optional browser preview.

interface.longDescription: Turn typed notes into polished handwritten PDF, Word, or PNG pages locally. Includes measured collision-safe layout, deterministic variation, pagination, agent tooling, and no cloud upload.
defaultPrompt: Turn these notes into ruled handwritten pages
Create a neat handwritten PDF from this text
Export these notes as a handwritten Word document
Render my notes privately with a reproducible style
